attr.title: ECHOFIELD
attr.desc: An original, experimental granular sampler. Record your FM-1 (or any class-compliant USB audio device) straight into the handheld and turn it into clouds, shards, tape smears, ghosts, pulses and drifting textures.
attr.inst: Ready to run. Connect a USB audio interface to the OTG port to record; factory samples are included.
